methodology.query: SELECT k, window_start, window_end, MIN(s), MAX(s), COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(TUMBLE(TABLE src, DESCRIPTOR(rt), INTERVAL '10' SECOND)) GROUP BY k, window_start, window_end
methodology.complete_job_boundary: SQL submission through rowwise collection; both transposes, JNI, state and scheduling timed; shared cluster startup and input registration excluded
methodology.engine_order: Stock/native/forced fallback rotate within each variant JVM; main then candidate JVMs run sequentially
methodology.native_baseline: Unmodified main #336 production Java and Rust; matching Criterion harness added for measurement
methodology.candidate: Main #336 plus contiguous primitive/UTF-8 selections through Arrow slices; no production Java or admission changes
methodology.single_phase: Both variants explicitly opt in; default stays disabled
methodology.native_work: Every native job requires positive consumed rows from each expected window stage, filtered to its current job ID
methodology.parity: Every trial compares stock/native/fallback values and RowKinds
limitations: Separate main/candidate JVMs have differing stock baselines; native-before/after ratios are observations rather than confidence bounds.
Short complete jobs vary by about 0.1 seconds; all samples and unfavorable controls are retained.
These are TUMBLE diagnostics, not exhaustive HOP/CUMULATE or recovery throughput claims.
Criterion excludes JVM/JNI and uses the unaccounted-budget adapter; allocation requests are not copied bytes or peak memory.
